blocks.orig: During this 13 days Tanzania Safari & Zanzibar tour you will discover that Tanzania is a land of superlatives. Home to the highest concentration of wildlife (Ngorongoro Crater), the highest mountain (Kilimanjaro), most famous National Park (Serengeti), the largest overland migration of wildlife and the world’s best beaches (Zanzibar). Enjoy 13 days full of highlights.
blocks.html: Over the 13 days of this Tanzania Safari & Zanzibar tour, you will find out why Tanzania is called a land of superlatives. It has the highest density of wildlife (Ngorongoro Crater), the tallest mountain (Kilimanjaro), the best-known National Park (Serengeti), the biggest overland wildlife migration and the world’s best beaches (Zanzibar). Thirteen days packed with highlights lie ahead of you.

blocks.orig: This private safari offers you the flexibility to travel at your own pace, exactly the way you like it. You will have a private safari vehicle and guide.
blocks.html: Because this safari is private, you set the pace and travel just the way you prefer. A safari vehicle and a guide are reserved for you alone.

blocks.orig: Many travelers ask us when the best time is to visit Tanzania. The answer is … there is not one right answer. It depends on what you want to see, where you want to go, your budget and interests. Please find a comprehensive guide on when is the best time to visit Tanzania here.
blocks.html: A question we often hear from travellers is when to visit Tanzania. Honestly … no single answer fits everyone. It comes down to what you hope to see, the places you want to go, your budget and what interests you. You can read our detailed guide on the best time to visit Tanzania here.

blocks.orig: Our safaris in Tanzania offer an opportunity to explore the country’s incredible wildlife and stunning landscapes. We specialize in private safaris, which means you have a 4×4 Landcruiser or jeep all to yourselves. You have the flexibility to decide when the safari starts and ends, and our experienced guides can help you make that decision on the day of your adventure. Whether you want to witness the animals at their most active during sunrise and sunset when temperatures are pleasant, or if you fancy ending the day by the pool, it’s entirely up to you. Tanzania’s diverse wildlife is active at various times of the day, so you’ll have plenty of opportunities to spot the animals in action.
blocks.html: With our Tanzania safaris you get the chance to discover the country’s remarkable wildlife and striking scenery. Private safaris are our speciality, so the 4×4 Landcruiser or jeep is yours alone. You choose when each safari day begins and finishes, and our experienced guides are happy to help you decide on the day itself. Perhaps you want to see the animals when they are most active around sunrise and sunset, when it is pleasantly cool, or perhaps you would rather finish the day at the pool: the choice is yours. Because Tanzania’s wildlife is active at different moments of the day, you’ll have many chances to see the animals on the move.

blocks.orig: At Your Tanzania Trip, we’re all about co-creating your perfect journey. When you plan your Tanzania adventure with us, you’re not just booking a trip; you’re embarking on a personalized experience. We start by understanding your wishes and preferences, and we won’t stop until every aspect of your journey aligns perfectly with your vision. Our team works closely with you to ensure that your entire trip is tailor-made to your satisfaction. And for added convenience, we offer a selection of our most popular Tanzania trips and safaris as a starting point for your consideration.
blocks.html: Your Tanzania Trip is about shaping your ideal journey together with you. Planning your Tanzania adventure with us means more than reserving a trip; it means starting on an experience built around you. We begin by listening to your wishes and preferences, and we keep going until every part of the journey matches what you have in mind. Our team stays in close contact with you so the whole trip is tailor-made to your liking. To make things easier, we also share a selection of our most popular Tanzania trips and safaris that you can use as a starting point.

blocks.orig: Absolutely, Tanzania is renowned as one of the prime destinations to encounter the Big Five. These magnificent creatures—lion, leopard, elephant, rhinoceros, and buffalo—can be observed in their natural habitats, making Tanzania a preferred choice for wildlife enthusiasts.
blocks.html: Yes, Tanzania is known as one of the best places to see the Big Five. You can watch these impressive animals—lion, leopard, elephant, rhinoceros and buffalo—in their natural surroundings, which is why so many wildlife lovers choose Tanzania.

blocks.orig: Absolutely, Tanzania is a safe and welcoming destination for travelers. The country offers a hospitable environment, especially in tourist areas like Arusha, and you can explore its beautiful landscapes and wildlife with confidence. Local people are friendly, and safety measures, such as keeping an eye on your belongings, are always advisable, just as you would in any other part of the world. Tanzania’s natural beauty and the warmth of its people make it a fantastic place to visit.
blocks.html: Yes, Tanzania is a safe and friendly country to travel in. You will find a welcoming atmosphere, particularly in tourist areas such as Arusha, and you can enjoy its landscapes and wildlife with peace of mind. People are friendly, and it is always sensible to take ordinary precautions, like watching your belongings, as you would anywhere else in the world. Thanks to its natural beauty and the warmth of its people, Tanzania is a wonderful place to visit.

blocks.orig: As you walk out of Kilimanjaro International Airport, your personal Your Tanzania Trip guide greets you with a big smile: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' The guide takes you straight to your hotel, where you can relax and take in the African atmosphere. The next day your guide takes you on an exclusive, private safari that allows you to travel at your own pace. Enjoy the luxury of your own safari jeep and take the liberty to stop and watch the animals as long as you like!
blocks.html: When you step outside Kilimanjaro International Airport, your own Your Tanzania Trip guide is there to welcome you with a broad smile: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' You are driven directly to your hotel to unwind and soak up the African atmosphere. The following day your guide sets off with you on an exclusive, private safari where you decide the pace. You have your own safari jeep, so feel free to stop and watch the animals for as long as you wish!

blocks.orig: Today is a wonderful relaxing day, that you can spend in whatever way you like. Choose to spend the whole day at the lodge to enjoy the excellent service, sip on refreshing drinks, lounge near the pool, and just engulf yourself in the African vibes surrounding you. Or get to know Arusha through some interesting activities - go for example on a city tour, explore the outskirts of the city by mountain bike, or score your first souvenirs at an exhilarating Maasai market…
blocks.html: This is a lovely, relaxed day to fill exactly as you please. You could stay at the lodge all day, enjoying the excellent service, sipping cool drinks, lazing by the pool and simply taking in the African atmosphere around you. Or you could discover Arusha through a few interesting activities - take a city tour, for instance, cycle through the outskirts of town by mountain bike, or pick up your first souvenirs at a lively Maasai market…

blocks.orig: Today you will go for your first actual game drive, in Arusha National Park! This park close to Arusha is known for its abundance of tropical birds, the presence of the black and white Colobus monkey and some rare albino baboons. You will probably spot the Colobus monkey and some rare bird species such as the gorgeous Silvery Cheeked Hornbill, and, if you are very lucky, even an albino. The park also has a lake, a few craters, waterfalls, mountains, and beautiful grassy planes.
blocks.html: Your first real game drive takes place today, in Arusha National Park! Close to Arusha, this park is famous for its many tropical birds, the black and white Colobus monkey and a few rare albino baboons. Chances are you will see the Colobus monkey and rare birds like the lovely Silvery Cheeked Hornbill, and with a lot of luck even an albino. Inside the park you will also find a lake, several craters, waterfalls, mountains and lovely grassy plains.

blocks.orig: Today you can relax at your hotel to enjoy the friendly service, or go out and about through a range of activities! You can for example visit the beautiful Mount Meru waterfalls. A short hike leads you there, after which you can take a refreshing swim in the cold water beneath the waterfall. Have your lunch in these quiet surroundings amidst singing birds and meandering water and try and spot the amazing Colobus monkey or the Silvery Cheeked Hornbill on your way back!
blocks.html: You can spend today relaxing at the hotel and enjoying the friendly service, or head out for one of a number of activities! One option is a visit to the lovely Mount Meru waterfalls. After a short walk you reach them and can cool off with a swim in the cold water at the foot of the falls. Eat your lunch in this peaceful spot surrounded by birdsong and flowing water, and look out for the remarkable Colobus monkey or the Silvery Cheeked Hornbill on the way back!

blocks.orig: Tarangire National Park is well known for its big groups of elephants and the huge amount of giant baobab trees. These trees can live for hundreds of years and are actually a source of water for elephants in the dry season as they have a special technique to draw water from them. Besides, the Tarangire River is the only source of water in the dry season, which is why in this season in Tarangire you can see groups of up to 250 elephants next to many more animals!
blocks.html: Tarangire National Park is famous for its large elephant herds and its huge number of giant baobab trees. Baobabs can survive for hundreds of years, and in the dry season elephants actually use them as a water source, thanks to a special way of drawing water out of them. On top of that, the Tarangire River is the only water source during the dry season, so at that time of year you can see herds of up to 250 elephants in Tarangire alongside many other animals!

blocks.orig: Serengeti National Park is widely known as the place to go on safari, mainly because of the Great Migration that passes through here. The enormous, stampeding herds are impressive, as are the vast number of predators that live here: over four thousand lions, over 200 cheetahs, a thousand leopards, 3500 hyenas, and hundreds of wild dogs! And of course, plenty of other beautiful animals, which your guide will be delighted to search for together with you. Are you ready for this?
blocks.html: Serengeti National Park is known far and wide as the place for a safari, largely thanks to the Great Migration that moves through it. The huge, thundering herds are a sight to behold, and so is the large number of predators living here: more than four thousand lions, over 200 cheetahs, a thousand leopards, 3500 hyenas and hundreds of wild dogs! There are many other lovely animals too, and your guide will gladly look for them with you. Are you ready?

blocks.orig: The famous Ngorongoro Crater is one of Africa's seven natural wonders. The crater was formed two million years ago when a vast volcano erupted. The fertile lava has created a unique ecosystem, now home to the highest concentration of animals found anywhere in Africa! Once in the crater, thousands of animals such as lions, zebras, buffalos and black rhinos surround you, and the views are astounding – you won’t know where to look!
blocks.html: The well-known Ngorongoro Crater counts as one of Africa's seven natural wonders. It took shape two million years ago when a huge volcano erupted. The rich volcanic soil created a one-of-a-kind ecosystem that now holds the highest density of animals anywhere in Africa! Down in the crater you are surrounded by thousands of animals, including lions, zebras, buffalos and black rhinos, and the scenery is stunning – you won’t know which way to look!

blocks.orig: Today you fly to the spice island of Zanzibar. Our guide picks you up at the airport and takes you to your hotel. Over the next few days, you can discover white sandy beaches, crystal-clear turquoise waters and vibrant coral reefs. Into culture? Then head to Stone Town and dive into the history of this fascinating little town. Food lovers can also visit the spice plantations and discover the diverse flavours of the delicious local cuisine. A tropical paradise awaits you!
blocks.html: Today you take a flight to Zanzibar, the spice island. Our guide meets you at the airport and drives you to your hotel. In the days ahead you can explore white sandy beaches, clear turquoise water and colourful coral reefs. Interested in culture? Go to Stone Town and immerse yourself in the history of this intriguing small town. If you love food, you can also tour the spice plantations and get to know the many flavours of the tasty local cuisine. A tropical paradise is waiting for you!

blocks.orig: Ultimate paradise is here: gorgeous, tropical Zanzibar! The clear blue waters of the Indian Ocean and the palm-fringed, white sandy beaches are almost too beautiful to be true. Buy your coconut drink fresh on the beach, spend hours sunbathing or swimming, and taste the delicious Zanzibari food. In the mood for something active? Then explore the beach, ocean, and island through a range of activities! We highly recommend the Safari Blue Cruise or a tour of Stone Town.
blocks.html: This is paradise at its finest: beautiful, tropical Zanzibar! The Indian Ocean’s clear blue water and the white sandy beaches lined with palms seem almost too lovely to be real. Get a fresh coconut drink on the beach, sunbathe or swim for hours, and try the tasty Zanzibari food. Feeling active? Discover the beach, the ocean and the island through a variety of activities! The Safari Blue Cruise and a Stone Town tour are both warmly recommended.

blocks.orig: The last day! Depending on your flight time, you can relax on the beach or explore the island just a little bit more. Then, make your way to Zanzibar International Airport in time for your flight home. Having second thoughts? It's also possible to extend your holiday to another paradise island, such as Mnemba, Pemba, or Mafia!
blocks.html: Your final day! Depending on when your flight leaves, you can unwind on the beach or see a little more of the island. Afterwards you head to Zanzibar International Airport in good time for your flight home. Not ready to leave? You can also add time on another paradise island, such as Mnemba, Pemba or Mafia!
